entries.title: countUnits loops one position past the end of the cart
entries.description: countUnits loops with `i <= items.length`, one position past the end of the array, and reads `items[items.length].quantity` (TypeError).

entries.title: percentOff returns the discount instead of the reduced total
entries.description: percentOff returns the discount amount instead of the discounted total: `total * percent / 100` instead of `total - total * percent / 100`; a 15 % code turns 100 EUR into 15 EUR.

entries.title: saveOrder without await inside try, so the catch never runs
entries.description: saveOrder is called without await inside the try block; a rejected promise never reaches the catch, the reservations are not released, and the order counts as created.

entries.title: Default order options are mutated through the shared tags array
entries.description: Without explicit options the shared DEFAULT_OPTIONS object is mutated (`options.tags.push("bulk")`); all later orders without options then carry the `bulk` tag.

entries.title: Duplicate SKU throws without releasing the reservations
entries.description: On a duplicate SKU an exception is thrown after the reservation succeeded, without releasing the reservations (unlike the other error paths, which call releaseAll).

entries.title: Cents formatted as euros in the API response
entries.description: After the change cartTotal returns cents instead of euros; the API response still formats order.total with formatEuro and shows a hundred times the amount.

entries.title: Refund ignores the order currency
entries.description: Orders now carry a currency, but refundOrder does not pass order.currency to issueRefund; refunds of CHF orders are booked as EUR.

entries.title: Documented fall-through in describeCode
entries.description: describeCode falls through from `seasonal` to `percent` in its switch.
entries.rationale: A seasonal code is a percentage code with an expiry date. With a date the seasonal branch returns its own text; only a seasonal code without a date reaches the percent branch, which describes it correctly as a plain percentage. The `falls through` comment marks the fall-through by the usual lint convention, and the branch touches no amount.

entries.title: Non-null assertion on the optional customer
entries.description: Non-null assertion `order.customer!.email` although customer is optional.
entries.rationale: sendConfirmation is only called in createOrder, after validateOrder, which throws when the customer is missing.

entries.title: Loop bound items.length - 1 in hasDuplicateSku
entries.description: Loop only up to `items.length - 1` in hasDuplicateSku.
entries.rationale: Neighbouring pairs `items[i]` and `items[i + 1]` are compared; the last index has no successor, so the bound is correct. The only caller sorts by SKU first.

entries.title: Loose equality req.code == null
entries.rationale: `== null` deliberately checks for `null` and `undefined` at once; the field is declared optional as `string | null`.
